class.name: NNSTBranchNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for state tree nodes that can contain active child states ([NNSTRoot] and [NNSTTickedNodes]).
class.description: Provides child state selection ([member child_state_selection_rule]), event dispatching ([method send_event]), and active-state input hooks ([method on_input], [method on_unhandled_input], and [method on_unhandled_key_input]) that only receive input while the state is active.

method.name: get_is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while this state is currently active.

method.name: on_input
method.description: Called like [method Node._input], but only while this state is active.

method.name: on_unhandled_input
method.description: Called like [method Node._unhandled_input], but only while this state is active.

method.name: on_unhandled_key_input
method.description: Called like [method Node._unhandled_key_input], but only while this state is active.

method.name: send_event
method.description: Sends a named event to the state tree. Delivered to the innermost active state first and bubbles upward until a matching [NNSTTransition] consumes it. Events sent during callbacks are queued and processed in order.

members.member: How a child state is chosen on entry: [code]OnEnterConditionMethod[/code] ([code]0[/code]) picks the first enabled child whose [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_enter_condition] returns [code]true[/code]; [code]UtilityScoring[/code] ([code]1[/code]) picks the child with the highest consideration score. Ignored by [NNSTParallel].
